On my lunch break, I overheard a White lady and a Middle Eastern guy talking about their spouses. The White lady was talking about how they cook together every Saturday, but the Middle Eastern guy seemed appalled by the idea of helping to cook, and reported not even liking their spouse leaving the house when there was still housework to be done. Who is respectful of their spouse?
A. Cannot be determined
B. The Middle Eastern guy
C. The White lady
